svg.title: Contact, Sathish Lella
svg.desc: A moonlit meadow at night with a dirt path, two lamp posts, swaying grass and fireflies. The guide in a red cap and grey hoodie stands large on the right and waves goodbye. The words read 05 / CONTACT, Let's build something, Thank you for walking with me. Available for select AI engineering engagements: multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines and production AI infrastructure.
